description: Roshan Packages Limited is a packaging manufacturer established in 2002 within the Roshan Group, producing corrugated packaging, flexible packaging and co-extruded films from two plants, and serving textile, food and beverage, pharmaceutical and FMCG customers. The company states that a recycled-paper mill at Sheikhupura is being developed in stages, with bank financing approved.
headOffice: 325 G-III, M.A. Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan
